label: db: user, database and a password kept out of this file
code:
environment:
  POSTGRES_USER: rocket
  POSTGRES_DB: rocket
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_password
secrets:
  - db_password

label: db: keep the data files across down and up
db: readiness check and network exposure
code:
healthcheck:
  test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U rocket -d rocket"]
  interval: 5s
  timeout: 3s
  retries: 10
  start_period: 10s

label: migrate: where to reach the database
migrate: start only when the database is ready
api: where to reach the database
api: publish port 3000 for Nginx on the same host
api: start after the database and the migrations
code:
depends_on:
  db:
    condition: service_healthy
  migrate:
    condition: service_completed_successfully

label: Declare the named volume and the secret files
code:
volumes:
  pgdata:

secrets:
  db_password:
    file: ./secrets/db_password.txt
  jwt_secret:
    file: ./secrets/jwt_secret.txt

label: api: where to reach the database
db: readiness check and network exposure
code:
healthcheck:
  test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U rocket -d rocket"]
  interval: 5s
  timeout: 3s
  retries: 10
  start_period: 10s
ports:
  - "5432:5432"

label: migrate: start only when the database is ready
